[2:30PM] #OkotaIsolo #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic along Cele toward Ago Roundabout is flowing smoothly, and the return journey is also clear. The Cele Link Bridge inward toward Ijesha, including access to Ijesha Market, is equally free in both directions. The inner part of Nwachukwu Drive connecting to Cele is also moving well with no delays reported in either direction.

Ago Palace Way toward Apple Junction is encouraging at the moment, with both inward and outward movements experiencing good flow. Ibeh, Apata, and Transformer Junction inward toward Ilasa Service Lane are all good to go, and the return journey remains clear.

The inner section of Ire Akari connecting to Osolo Road is moving without hindrance in both directions. Traffic from Chemist inward Pako is also free, alongside the return movement. Along Oke Afa, the stretch toward Lasutech Roundabout remains clear in both directions.

Daleko Bridge inward toward Palm Avenue is also moving smoothly, with no major issues reported either way. Likewise, Five Star and Iyana Isolo inward  Ijesha Express, including both the main and service lanes, are flowing well. The only notable impediment is at the Cele Service Lane inward toward Ijesha Express, where delays are currently observed.

#FollowLASTMA
